messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

The relation 'can lead to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or event may result in the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'known as': The subject medical condition is also referred to by the name specified by the object entity.
B. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
E. 'caused by': The subject condition is caused by the pathogen or factor specified by the object entity.
